answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 13 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 580 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the reef here is verification, the anchor of cost is what stops the farm, and the lotus of the record keeps every claim checkable.
